display_name: LoRa R17 三方向实频谱幅度融合
description: 冻结 LoRa 实增益、R02/R07/R17 与 E104，增加先验频谱实幅度方向，与伴随残差和 R17 差异方向共同训练。
authorization: 当前聊天 01a2204f-647a-7903-ba29-81cfe8f8749b 的融合研发目标及 N607 有显存即启动要求。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI PyTorch CUDA FP32 TF32off, independent CPU scorer

data.representation: 8192 complex points in 8 x 1024 chirps; frozen W24 E104/default head
data.physical_ids_ref: V RX b200_1: seed 2026112899 choose 300 IDs excluding all previous source screens (60+300+300+300 IDs)
data.label_map_ref: TX31-40 mapped 0-9; L_s labels only in training, U_s true TX hidden; source V truth only in independent scorer
target_receivers: 15 registered held-out LoRa RX remain unopened by this run
data.validation_ref: Existing VALIDATED_ONCE source contract and physical ID ordering
data.leo_config_ref: Registered source Full clean and practical_low_urban views

permissions.claim_scope: LoRa L_s true CE and frozen E104 clean U_s pseudo CE >=0.95 explicitly allowed by same-contract native E104 predecessor. U_s true TX hidden; V and target excluded from updates. V truth read separately only after clean and low-urban predictions freeze.

checkpoint.initialization: Same-contract LoRa realgain, R02/R07/R17 and E104 frozen; new three-direction real-gain head zero initialized. Previous candidates used only to exclude exposed screening IDs.

sources.role: frozen same-contract LoRa realgain prior; inherited E104 supervised and U pseudo-label history
same-contract R02/R07 context and R17 three-prior unrolled reference
frozen E104 source teacher and original default head, source-V selected E104

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Prior frozen checkpoints and same lora_rx5_main_v1:392005 role/receiver/ten-class identities; strict loads
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No cross-dataset checkpoint. LoRa source-only pretarget fixed weights; historic target results have been exposed and source V used by E104 selection.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Final 1500-step checkpoint; low urban same-packet net >=2 in each deterministic half of 300 vs direct, native LoRa R17 and realgain; clean net >=-2 against each; 2000 paired bootstrap 95% interval.

execution.gpu_policy: One worker; first GPU with >=8192 MiB free in order 5,7,2,3,6,1,4,0; concurrent WiSig worker preserved.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on illegal source/checkpoint, output collision, nonfinite update, absent finite nonzero first-step gradients for all three directions, incomplete predictions or scorer failure. Preserve other owners and outputs.

dimensions: 300 fresh source V physical IDs excluding prior 60+300+300+300

rows.method: Frozen LoRa realgain plus real-valued amplitude of prior spectrum, R07 adjoint residual and R17 difference, supervised by frozen E104.
rows.seed_notes: Selection seed +2 chooses RX V IDs without labels, +3 assigns halves. No support.
rows.optimizer: AdamW weight_decay 1e-4 cosine 1e-4 to 1e-5, gradient clip 1
rows.budget_ref: 1500 updates, each 8 L_s + 8 U_s; 12000 exposures per role; inherited training cost separate

notes: Excludes 60+300+300+300 prior source screening IDs; E104 source V selected historically and target benchmark previously exposed.
LoRa source-contract parent checkpoints only; no cross-dataset weight transfer.
Three-direction gain coefficients: 0.1 prior spectrum and 0.25 each physical residual and R17-minus-prior. Same 1500-step recognition-retention loss as prior candidate.
U true TX hidden; E104 frozen teacher for U pseudolabels and source supervision; no V/target training.
Full target seven-view evaluation and matching DURA v1 LoRa control remain outstanding.
